description: A festival exhibition curator must approve the public opening plan for an immersive audiovisual installation and lock its exhibition mode, visitor throughput, accessibility provisions, press restrictions, and credits.

shared_context.S1: The festival plans to present the immersive audiovisual installation "Tidal Memory" in Gallery 4 from October 12 through October 15.
shared_context.S2: Maya has final authority to approve the installation's public opening plan.
shared_context.S3: The current draft plan proposes online-connected playback, eight visitor stations, 15-minute sessions, and a 5:00 PM public opening on October 12.
shared_context.S4: The festival's daily production huddle includes a routine final check in which rights, technical, accessibility, and artist representatives state any conditions that must be added before an exhibition plan is approved.

PF1.text: Leon reviewed the countersigned music license this morning and confirmed that Tidal Memory may be exhibited only through offline local playback, may not be photographed or recorded by visitors, and must use the exact credit line "Music licensed from Harborlight Editions"; he has not amended the exhibition packet because the license arrived after the packet was circulated.

PF2.text: Sora completed the headset and network test after yesterday's installation rehearsal and found that the approved headset model supports only six simultaneous stations, with each session limited to exactly 12 minutes to prevent thermal shutdown; the test report is still in the equipment vendor's queue.

PF3.text: Nadia confirmed with the festival's access consultant today that one of the six stations must be a seated, step-free station and that every visitor notice must display the exact warning "Flashing light and sudden sound"; the consultant's written confirmation was received after the draft visitor signage was sent to print.

PF4.text: Felix confirmed with the artist's manager this afternoon that the artist will permit public access on October 12 only from 6:00 PM onward and will not permit press or invited photographers inside before that opening; the manager's email is awaiting entry in the artist file.

acceptance_conditions: Playback must use offline local playback.
The installation must operate with exactly six visitor stations.
Each visitor session must last exactly 12 minutes.
Exactly one station must be seated and step-free.
The required flashing-light and sudden-sound warning must appear on visitor notices.
Public access must begin at exactly 6:00 PM on October 12.
Press and invited photographers must not enter before public opening.
Visitor photography and recording must be prohibited.
The exact Harborlight Editions credit must be displayed.
A rights-restriction commitment must be logged.
A technical-capacity commitment must be logged.
An accessibility-signage commitment must be logged.
An artist-opening restriction commitment must be logged.

decisive_facts.why: The license changes playback from online-connected to offline local, changes visitor recording from allowed to prohibited, and replaces the draft credit with the exact Harborlight Editions wording.
The equipment test changes the plan from eight stations and 15-minute sessions to exactly six stations and exactly 12-minute sessions.
The access confirmation changes the accessible-station count to exactly one and adds the exact warning text "Flashing light and sudden sound" to visitor notices.
The artist's confirmed condition moves public opening from 5:00 PM to exactly 6:00 PM and changes pre-opening press access from allowed to prohibited.
